chunks: Zurarah narrated from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام that he said:

If you say takbīr at the beginning of your salat after the opening, with twenty-one takbīrs, then you forget all the takbīr or do not say it, the first takbīr suffices for you for the takbīrat of the entire salat.

key_terms.التَّكْبِيرُ الْأَوَّلُ: the first takbīr at the prayer’s opening
key_terms.تَكْبِيرَةِ الصَّلَاةِ: the opening takbīr of the prayer

ai.seo_question: If I forget the additional opening takbīrs in salat, is the first takbīr enough?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning takbīr at the opening of salat. It states that if a person begins the prayer and later forgets the additional takbīrs, the first takbīr is sufficient for the validity of the prayer’s opening.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1002 – Zurarah narrated from Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) that He said:

"When you say the Takbir at the beginning of your prayer after the opening Takbir (Takbir al-Ihram), if you say twenty-one Takbirs and then forget the remaining Takbirs, or fail to say them, the first Takbir will suffice for all the Takbirs in the prayer”.
